item.title: Divers find body of man who fell through ice in Eastham
item.description: Divers have recovered the body of an Eastham man who fell through the ice with his wife at First Encounter Beach over the weekend, according to police.

item.title: Providence hires firm to conduct independent review of city's response to Brown University shooting
item.description: Providence Mayor Brett Smiley announced Thursday that an outside firm has been hired to conduct an independent review of the city's response to the deadly shooting at Brown University late last year.

item.title: What to know about the Supreme Court's ruling on President Trump's tariffs
item.description: The Supreme Court issued a ruling Friday, striking down some of President Donald Trump's wide-reaching tariffs. Liam Malloy is an associate professor and chair of the Economics Department at the University of Rhode Island. He spoke with 12 News to answer questions about the recent ruling.

item.title: Rochester girl, 11, dies in avalanche while vacationing in Utah
item.description: An 11-year-old Massachusetts girl died Thursday in an avalanche while vacationing with her family in Utah, according to the Unified Police Department.

item.title: RI troopers, charity donate $5K to Warwick family touched by cancer: 'It's why we do this'
item.description: Each year, Rhode Island State Police troopers run the Boston Marathon to raise money for a charity that supports kids with cancer and their families.
